## Goal
- Implement issue-004 for mixed-domain salvage-aware recovery.
- Make interrupted/provider-failed mixed-domain runs:
  - promote to `review_ready` when preserved diff + local passing proof exist
  - become resumable `blocked` lanes when preserved diff exists but proof does not
- Keep queue/task/operator-facing state from remaining misleadingly `failed` when salvage evidence exists.

  - `.pi/agent/extensions/worker-execution.ts`
  - `.pi/agent/extensions/queue-runner.ts`

- `.pi/agent/extensions/worker-execution.ts`
